# Confirm reopening a closed opportunity restores dashboard counts

## What & Why
The dashboard now has coverage proving Closed opportunities stay out of active totals. A complementary regression should verify that changing the same opportunity back to an active status makes the correct count return after reload, so the summary cannot become permanently stale.

## Done looks like
- A browser test in artifacts/escape-hatch/tests/persistence.spec.ts creates an opportunity, closes it, reopens it as Saved or Applied, and verifies the matching dashboard count returns.
- The reopened status and count both persist after reload.

## Relevant files
- artifacts/escape-hatch/src/App.tsx
- artifacts/escape-hatch/tests/persistence.spec.ts
